ICS 71.100.60PCD 18Reaffirmed 20221. Scope1.1 This standard describes the materials to be used for the containers intended for containing essential oils, depending on the end use.1.2 It also gives general rules and recommendations relating to the properties of these containers, their conditioning and storage.NOTE - Essential oils are used for different purposes, for example, perfumery and cosmetic use; reference samples or test samples; industrial raw materials etc.
